title: Deobstruct

inlines.v: DEOBSTRUCT, verb transitive [Latin To stop; to pile.] To remove obstructions, or impediments to a passage; to clear from any thing that hinders the passage of fluids in the proper ducts of the body; as, to deobstruct the pores or lacteals.
